# Design Catalog

> Letterpress study desk of AI design techniques — mostly Anshu Chimala (Discover → Define → Deliver), with partial catalogs of Nate Parrott (Claude Design) and Greg Huntoon (TC-EBC). Public sources only. No endorsement.

Base URL: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app
Repo: https://github.com/Btheriot83/design-catalog

## For agents (prefer these over HTML scraping)

- Index: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/data/index.json
- All techniques: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/data/techniques.json
- One technique: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/data/techniques/{slug}.json
- Designers: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/data/designers.json
- Prompts library: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/data/prompts.json
- Sources: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/data/sources.json
- Free craft resources: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/data/resources.json
- Shipaton 2025 winners: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/data/shipaton-2025.json
- Schemas: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/schema/technique.schema.json · designer.schema.json
- Full agent guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Btheriot83/design-catalog/main/docs/FOR_AGENTS.md
- This file (full): https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

Optional API aliases (same JSON; prefer /data/ for CDN cache):
- /api/index · /api/techniques · /api/designers · /api/prompts · /api/sources · /api/resources · /api/shipaton-2025

## Key human routes

- /techniques · /prompts · /compare (field guide) · /designers · /sources · /resources · /shipaton-2025 · /agents · /about · /motion

## How to use (short)

1. Fetch /data/index.json
2. Pick technique(s) by stage or Anshu 1–8 mapping in the index
3. Copy prompts from /data/prompts.json or technique JSON
4. Run Discover → Define → Deliver; write docs/DISCOVER.md, DEFINE.md, DELIVER.md

Canonical improvement path (Tileboard / chore-app): see index.canonicalApps.tileboard and docs/FOR_AGENTS.md.
